value.rationale: The entire containment-depth function for a natural independently side-stratified random convex hull is determined across every host triangle. Unlike area-only statistics, the pointwise map identifies the unique most reliably covered host location, gives a strict majorization ordering of locations, and quantifies anisotropic loss of coverage through binary entropy near a vertex. These are structural geometric probability facts, not merely the known area moment recomputed.
